verdict_reason: The move to ApiDocs and @MockitoBean is sound and the run instructions now live in the README, but the only assertion reads back what the method just wrote and cannot fail.

todos.issue: The only assertion, assertThat(Files.readString(ApiDocs.COMMITTED_ARTIFACT)).isEqualTo(rendered) (:47), reads back the string the line above (:45) just wrote. No production line can turn it red: it checks the filesystem, not the application. The freshness of the artifact is already proved by AddressComplianceIT.committedArtifactIsNotStaleAgainstTheLiveApiDocs.
todos.fix: Must: the generator carries no assertion on a value it wrote itself. One way: drop the read-back and let the method be a plain generator (suppress Sonar java:S2699 on it, with the README section explaining the run), or move generation to a small main class run by exec-maven-plugin so it is not a test at all.
